name: Kuan Fang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: GRILL develops generalizable manipulation using heterogeneous human/robot data and learned interaction representations. UMA unifies action prediction and dynamics modeling; KITE transfers manipulation between different bodies. These are very close matches to physical foundation-model research.

physicalEvidence.summary: UMA (June 2026) runs on a physical Franka FR3 with Robotiq 2F-85 and ZED RGB-D sensing at 15 Hz, testing insertion, sweeping and jeans folding over 20 trials each. KITE separately deploys a learned policy on a Wuji hand and Tianji Marvin arm, with 7/10, 8/10 and 7/10 successes across three tasks.

shortVisit.summary: The dedicated outside-Cornell Visiting Researchers route links a complete questionnaire with current MS status, arbitrary institution, visit start/end dates, visa needs and financial-support circumstances. Submit the form and email as the joining page directs. These fields establish an inquiry route, not guaranteed hosting, visa support or funding; no minimum duration or summer 2027 capacity is stated.

name: Zhiwen Fan
title: Assistant Professor
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; affiliated Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: Behavior Uncloning edits diffusion and VLA policies to suppress undesirable behavior modes while retaining task competence. This supplies a concrete physical-learning direction within the lab’s broader spatial/world-model work.

physicalEvidence.summary: The 2026 MoRE primary paper evaluates four actual Franka Research 3 tasks: knife placement, bottle placement, obstacle-related block manipulation and VLA knife handover. Each target mode uses ten bottle trials or twenty trials for the other tasks. NavTrust adds a collaborative physical RealMan navigation experiment.

shortVisit.summary: The opening page explicitly recruits visiting students and interns. However, the current homepage qualifies research interns as US based. Whether that qualification also limits visiting students from abroad is unresolved, so this is a conditional inquiry route rather than a supported overseas internship opening.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong current policy-editing and VLA overlap alongside broader spatial AI research.
scoreReasons.physical: Physical MoRE FR3 trials are tied to a current supervised lead author; NavTrust alone remains collaborative and local visitor access is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit visitor invitation, conservatively capped because the homepage also says research interns must be US based.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current 2026 primary physical studies and September 2026 lab updates.
